mapper.insert: INSERT INTO drafts (id, user_id, title, content, content_json, cover_image, category_id, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{contentJson,typeHandler=com.financial.news.utils.BlockListTypeHandler}, #{coverImage}, #{categoryId}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, content, content_json, cover_image, category_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM drafts WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, user_id, title, content, cover_image, category_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM drafts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'draft' ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.update:
